created_at.description: The date and time when the import process was created.

kraken_identifier.description: The unique identifier assigned to this import within Kraken.

latest_error.description: The most recent error that occurred during the import process, if any.

latest_event.description: The most recent import event associated with the import process, if any.

modified_at.description: The date and time when the import process was last modified.

status.description: The current status of the import process.

data.description: Additional data associated with the import event, such as error codes and details.

occurred_at.description: The date and time when the import event was recorded.

code.description: The error code identifying the type of error that occurred.

detail.description: A detailed description of the error that occurred.

domain.description: The domain or context in which the error occurred.
